stories.title: UTSA survives UAB, controls own destiny of hosting championship game as they sit atop of American Conference alone
stories.summary: The Roadrunners held on for a tight 19-17 victory over UAB. And after losses by Memphis and North Texas, UTSA sits atop of the American Conference by themselves.

stories.title: Dog shot and killed during shooting incident on San Antonio’s northwest side, police say
stories.summary: A dog was shot and killed during an exchange of gunfire on San Antonio’s northwest side, according to police.

stories.title: His sister spent decades searching for answers. She learned he was found just before her death
stories.summary: John Richard Moulis' sister learned he had been identified just two days before her death.

stories.title: 90-year-old mowing lawns to get by in Fort Worth sparks community support
stories.summary: “I see him walking up my driveway with the cane and just barely moving baby steps up the driveway; he could hardly even push the lawnmower," Clarissa Calderon said.

stories.title: Texas lawmaker proposes 'Lorenzo Salgado Araujo Day' to honor Houston father killed by federal immigration officers
stories.summary: Texas Rep. Christina Morales filed a bill to designate July 7 as a day of remembrance for a Houston father killed by federal immigration officers.

stories.title: Fort Stockton residents taking their concerns about data centers to Austin
stories.summary: As major data center projects take shape across West Texas, Fort Stockton residents are raising concerns and taking their fight beyond Pecos County.

stories.title: Diet-friendly Thanksgiving side dishes
stories.summary: Beth Dooley joined KARE 11 Saturday with vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free side dish recipes.

stories.title: Father who helped family escape burning Houston townhome dies from injuries
stories.summary: A father who suffered severe burns while helping his family escape a burning Heights townhome has died, according to the Buzbee Law Firm.

stories.title: Bastrop launches pilot program to help downtown businesses pay for live music
stories.summary: The city will cover 30% of eligible musician fees, reimbursing businesses up to $400 per performance, with a monthly cap of $1,200 per business.

stories.title: Family seeks answers after single mother of two struck and killed while walking puppy in NW Houston
stories.summary: Grecia Gonzalez was killed while walking her dog in northwest Houston. Her family is now calling for safety improvements as investigators seek answers.

stories.title: Inmate's escape attempt at Beaumont prison foiled by vigilant TDCJ staff
stories.summary: An inmate at the Larry Gist Unit attempted an escape early Friday but was swiftly recaptured by correctional officers, says the Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

stories.title: Bad fuel complaints leave Southeast Texas families facing thousands in repairs
stories.summary: 3 Southeast Texas families say bad fuel caused more than $10,000 in repairs. They are waiting on insurance decisions to find out if they are covered.
